Light where you work, nowhere else

Arc One puts a soft, glare-free pool of light exactly on your page or keyboard. Two friction joints hold any angle without knobs, and the shade turns a full 300° so you can bounce light off a wall when the day is done.
Each lamp is spun, powder-coated and assembled in small batches in Norway. The weighted base keeps a 46 cm reach steady, and the inline USB-C dimmer remembers your last setting.
